action.prompt: GUARDRAIL: You are about to write a file. If the target path matches .env, .env.*, *.pem, *.key or contains a string that looks like a token/secret (ghp_, sk-, AKIA, -----BEGIN), STOP. Do not write the file. Explain to the user that secrets are never written by the agent in this project (see .kiro/steering/tech.md) and tell them to add it manually. Otherwise continue.
